plans.name: runs.latest
plans.sql:
SELECT r.id,r.slug,r.revision,r.workspace,r.status,r.error,r.wake_at,r.next_retry_at,r.created_at,r.updated_at,r.owner_token,r.owner_pid,r.owner_host,r.heartbeat_at,
 CASE WHEN length(CAST(r.input_json AS BLOB))>16384 THEN 'null' ELSE r.input_json END AS input_json,
 CASE WHEN length(CAST(r.output_json AS BLOB))>16384 THEN 'null' ELSE r.output_json END AS output_json,
 length(CAST(r.input_json AS BLOB)) AS input_bytes,length(CAST(r.output_json AS BLOB)) AS output_bytes FROM runs r  ORDER BY r.created_at DESC,r.id DESC LIMIT ?

plans.name: runs.failed
plans.sql:
SELECT r.id,r.slug,r.revision,r.workspace,r.status,r.error,r.wake_at,r.next_retry_at,r.created_at,r.updated_at,r.owner_token,r.owner_pid,r.owner_host,r.heartbeat_at,
 CASE WHEN length(CAST(r.input_json AS BLOB))>16384 THEN 'null' ELSE r.input_json END AS input_json,
 CASE WHEN length(CAST(r.output_json AS BLOB))>16384 THEN 'null' ELSE r.output_json END AS output_json,
 length(CAST(r.input_json AS BLOB)) AS input_bytes,length(CAST(r.output_json AS BLOB)) AS output_bytes FROM runs r WHERE r.status=? ORDER BY r.created_at DESC,r.id DESC LIMIT ?

plans.name: counts.all
plans.sql: SELECT status,count(*) AS count FROM runs r  GROUP BY status

plan.detail: SCAN r USING COVERING INDEX runs_due

plans.name: logs.candidates
plans.sql: SELECT l.id,l.run_id AS runId,r.slug,r.workspace,r.status,l.seq,l.at,l.node_id AS nodeId,l.execution_key AS executionKey,l.attempt,l.level,substr(l.message,1,1024) AS message,l.data_bytes AS dataBytes,instr(lower(l.message),lower(?))>0 AS textMatches FROM logs l JOIN runs r ON r.id=l.run_id WHERE l.id<? ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT 2001

plan.detail: SEARCH l USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid<?)

plans.name: events.candidates
plans.sql: SELECT e.sequence,e.at,e.txn,e.run_id AS runId,COALESCE(r.slug,e.slug) AS slug,COALESCE(r.workspace,e.workspace) AS workspace,r.status,e.node_id AS nodeId,e.entity,e.kind FROM events e LEFT JOIN runs r ON r.id=e.run_id WHERE e.sequence<? ORDER BY e.sequence DESC LIMIT 2001

plan.detail: SEARCH e USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid<?)
SEARCH r USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_runs_1 (id=?) LEFT-JOIN

plans.name: executions.page
plans.sql: SELECT execution_key,CASE WHEN status='succeeded' AND length(CAST(output AS BLOB))>16384 THEN json_remove(json_set(record,'$.output',NULL),'$.inputView') ELSE json_remove(record,'$.inputView') END AS record,CASE WHEN status='succeeded' THEN length(CAST(output AS BLOB)) ELSE 0 END AS bytes FROM node_runs WHERE run_id=? AND scope=? ORDER BY execution_key LIMIT ?

plan.detail: SEARCH node_runs USING INDEX node_runs_scope (run_id=? AND scope=?)

plans.name: execution.attempts
plans.sql: SELECT attempt,length(CAST(record->'$.output' AS BLOB)) AS bytes,CASE WHEN json_type(record,'$.output') IS NOT NULL AND length(CAST(record->'$.output' AS BLOB))>16384 THEN json_set(record,'$.output',NULL) ELSE record END AS record FROM node_attempts WHERE run_id=? AND execution_key=? AND attempt>? ORDER BY attempt LIMIT 201

plan.detail: SEARCH node_attempts USING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_node_attempts_1 (run_id=? AND execution_key=? AND attempt>?)
